strongest_angle: Model Context Protocol (MCP) — connecting AI assistants to your data

key_facts.fact: AI assistants are constrained by their isolation from data — trapped behind information silos and legacy systems.
MCP is a universal, open standard for connecting AI systems with data sources.
Developers either expose their data through MCP servers or build AI applications (MCP clients) that connect to these servers.
MCP works like a USB-C port for AI applications — one standard port instead of a custom connector per data source.
Anthropic shares pre-built MCP servers for popular enterprise systems including Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Git, Postgres and Puppeteer.
MCP enables building once and integrating everywhere, giving AI systems access to the data where it lives.
